description: This is a Java unit test class for the AcknowledgementAggregator component, testing its behavior in aggregating acknowledgements, handling edge cases, and determining overall success/failure status.

classes.name: AcknowledgementAggregatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the functionality of AcknowledgementAggregator, including adding acknowledgment requests, received acknowledgments, and generating correct aggregated acknowledgements with proper statuses.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test setup, creating a correlation ID and DittoHeaders before each test.

methods.name: tryToAddNullRequestedAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Verifies that adding a null acknowledgement request throws NullPointerException with the appropriate message.

methods.name: emptyInstanceHasNoMissingAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Checks that a new AcknowledgementAggregator instance reports no missing acknowledgment labels.

methods.name: getMissingAcknowledgementLabelsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that missing acknowledgment labels are correctly identified based on added acknowledgements.

methods.name: tryToAddNullRequestedAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Ensures that adding null list of acknowledgement requests throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: emptyInstanceReceivedAllRequestedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Checks that a new instance reports all acknowledgements received as true.

methods.name: didNotReceiveAllRequestedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Verifies that the aggregator correctly reports incomplete acknowledgements.

methods.name: receivedAllRequestedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Verifies that the aggregator reports completion once all acknowledgements are received.

methods.name: onlyRegardFirstReceivedAcknowledgementForSameLabel
methods.description: Ensures that only the first received acknowledgment for a label is considered, ignoring subsequent duplicates.

methods.name: tryToAddNullReceivedAcknowledgement
methods.description: Verifies that adding a null acknowledgment throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: addFailedReceivedAcknowledgement
methods.description: Tests that a failed acknowledgment is properly recorded and affects the aggregation outcome.

methods.name: addSuccessfulReceivedAcknowledgement
methods.description: Tests that a successful acknowledgment is confirmed and the success status is updated.

methods.name: unknownReceivedAcknowledgementsAreIgnored
methods.description: Checks that acknowledgments not matching any request are ignored, especially for timeouts.

methods.name: successfulAcknowledgementsAreInExpectedOrder
methods.description: Verifies that successful acknowledgments are returned in the order they were received.

methods.name: failedAcknowledgementsAreInExpectedOrder
methods.description: Verifies that failed acknowledgments are returned in the order they were received.

methods.name: successfulAcknowledgementsLeadToHttpStatusCodeOK
methods.description: Ensures that aggregate status is OK when all acknowledgments are successful.

methods.name: acknowledgementsWithOneFailedLeadToHttpStatusCodeFailedDependency
methods.description: Verifies that presence of a failed acknowledgment results in a FAILED_DEPENDENCY status.

methods.name: acknowledgementsWithOneTimeoutLeadToHttpStatusCodeFailedDependency
methods.description: Verifies that a timeout acknowledgment causes the overall status to be FAILED_DEPENDENCY.

methods.name: tryToGetAggregatedAcknowledgementsForNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Checks that providing null DittoHeaders throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToGetAggregatedAcknowledgementsForDittoHeadersWithDifferentCorrelationId
methods.description: Ensures that supplying headers with a different correlation ID throws an IllegalArgumentException.
